{"code": "import re

# Read the markdown file as plain text
dict_text = open('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales_dictionary.md', 'r').read()

# Use regex to extract table rows (lines that start with | and end with |)
lines = dict_text.strip().split('\n')
md_table_lines = [line for line in lines if line.strip().startswith('|') and line.strip().endswith('|')]

# Extract field and description from each row
field_desc_pairs = []
for line in md_table_lines:
    # Split by pipe, remove empty strings and strip whitespace
    parts = [part.strip() for part in line.split('|') if part.strip()]
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        field = parts[0]
        description = ' '.join(parts[1:])
        field_desc_pairs.append((field, description))

# Convert to DataFrame
dict_df = pd.DataFrame(field_desc_pairs, columns=['Field', 'Description'])
dict_df.set_index('Field', inplace=True)
dict_df.loc[['customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue']]"}
